label: Anaximander's doctrine of opposing forces and cosmic retribution directly influenced Heraclitus' unity of opposites and cosmic fire
description: Heraclitus of Ephesus's philosophical system was decisively shaped by grappling with "The Apeiron (The Boundless)".
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "The Apeiron (The Boundless)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Pre-Socratic.
